note: Environment-neutral cron manifest (ADR 0028). No chat IDs, tokens, or absolute Dev-PC paths. HermesHomeProvisioner materializes this into <HERMES_HOME>/cron/jobs.json idempotently by logical `name`.

jobs.name: orbit-duty-scan-morning
jobs.prompt: Run the Orbit morning duty scan (see duty-scan skill). Pull calendar window, open blockers, and stalled waiting tasks via Orbit MCP tools. Rank next steps with evidence. After a material briefing, run briefing-distill for standing truths. Reply [SILENT] if nothing material changed since the last scan.

jobs.name: orbit-duty-scan-evening
jobs.prompt: Run the Orbit evening duty scan (see duty-scan skill). Recap the day: blockers cleared/opened, waiting tasks needing a chase, tomorrow's calendar. After a material briefing, run briefing-distill. Reply [SILENT] if nothing material changed since the morning scan.

jobs.name: orbit-pulse-monitor
jobs.prompt: The attached script output is the current Orbit Pulse snapshot. It only reaches you when it changed since the last tick. Rebuild awareness (see pulse-refresh skill): ensure active concerns have a brief + next action, report a short ranked briefing or [SILENT], then briefing-distill if material.

jobs.name: orbit-chase-waiting
jobs.prompt: Run the Orbit chase-waiting skill. List blocked/waiting tasks via Orbit MCP, identify stale dependencies, and update nextAction / brief with a concrete chase step — do not spam-send email. Reply [SILENT] if nothing is stale.
